name: 万象风鸣长弓

localizedSummaries.en-US: A starforged bow with four switchable forms and ten stages unlocked through boss progression.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用碎象星核合成长弓，切换苍风、炽焰、星轮、终焉四重形态，随 Boss 进度解锁十个境阶。

summary: A starforged bow with four switchable forms and ten stages unlocked through boss progression.
